guidance_fy26.src: Q2-26 release (Form 8-K Item 2.02, Ex. 99.1, 16-Jul-2026): FY2026 guidance raised across the board (initiated 22-Jan-2026 in the Q4-25 release; maintained 21-Apr-2026, trending to the high end)
guidance_fy26.adj_rev_growth_note: Model mapping of the qualitative 'high-teens' guide to 19% / 18% / 17% (high / mid / low) is an assumption.
guidance_fy26.ces_rev_growth_text: ~20% (prior: mid-teens); services low 20s (prior: mid-teens); equipment ~20% (prior: mid-to-high teens)
guidance_fy26.dpt_rev_growth_text: low double digits (prior: mid- to high-single digits)
guidance_fy26.corp_text: Corporate cost & eliminations (adjusted Corporate & Other operating costs): $(1.2)-(1.3)B per the Q4-25 release (22-Jan-2026); not restated in the Q1-26 / Q2-26 releases. The 16-Jul-2026 total and segment ranges imply about $(1.3)B at the mid-points.
guidance_fy26.segment_mapping_note: Qualitative segment guides (~20%, low 20s, low double digits) are mapped to numbers as assumptions (scenario high / mid / low).
guidance_fy26.history: 22-Jan-2026 (Q4-25 release): adjusted revenue +LDD; operating profit $9.85-10.25B; adjusted EPS $7.10-7.40; FCF $8.0-8.4B (>100% conversion); CES services +mid-teens, equipment +mid/high-teens, CES revenue +mid-teens, DPT revenue +MSD/HSD; CES operating profit $9.6-9.9B, DPT $1.55-1.65B, Corporate cost & eliminations $(1.2)-(1.3)B. 21-Apr-2026 (Q1-26 release): maintained, trending toward the high end. 16-Jul-2026 (Q2-26 release): adjusted revenue high-teens, operating profit $10.55-10.75B, adjusted EPS $7.65-7.85, FCF $8.9-9.2B; CES revenue ~+20% (services low 20s, equipment ~20%), CES operating profit $10.25-10.35B; DPT revenue low double digits, operating profit $1.6-1.7B.

seg_fy25_revised.src: Q4-25 release (8-K 22-Jan-2026) 'Full-Year 2026 Segment Guidance' table: 2025 revised for the Jan-2026 segment changes (Aeroderivative CES -> DPT; remaining T&O site revenue and cost from Corporate to the businesses); $bn, unaudited estimates.

cpp.src: Form 8-K 8-Sep-2026 (Items 7.01 / 8.01): Ex. 99.1 investor presentation and Ex. 99.2 press release.
cpp.text: Consolidated Precision Products (castings; ~6,600 employees, >20 facilities; ~60% commercial aerospace / ~20% defense / ~20% power and other; ~70% of revenue from commercial and defense engines). Purchase price $11.75bn (cash; financed with $7bn existing cash and new debt); ~18x 2027 EBITDA incl. expected net synergies, ~26x without (implies ~$452m 2027E EBITDA and ~$200m net synergies); ~$200m net synergies by year 3, >2x by year 6; adjusted EPS and FCF accretive in year 1 excluding one-time costs and deal-related amortization; double-digit ROIC by year 5; close expected 2H-2027 subject to regulatory approvals. CPP is a GE Aerospace supplier (LEAP, GEnx, T700, F110, F404).
cpp.assumptions: Not disclosed (model assumptions, flagged): closing date 30-Sep-2027 (one quarter in 2027E); revenue growth after 2027; EBITDA margin from the deck multiple; share of CPP revenue sold to GE Aerospace (eliminated on consolidation) 25%; PPA split (PP&E 15%, intangibles 35% amortized over 15 years, net working capital 5%, goodwill the remainder; no deferred-tax step-up); new-debt coupon 5.0%; one-time integration costs $150m in 2028E.

debt.src: FY2025 Form 10-K Note 10 (borrowings; long-term debt maturities) and Q2-26 Form 10-Q Note 10.
debt.at_2026_06_30: Total borrowings $19,157m at 30-Jun-2026 (short-term $2,000m incl. current portion of senior notes $1,786m; long-term $17,157m: senior notes $15,238m, subordinated $1,412m, other $507m). Senior notes average rate 4.00% at 31-Dec-2025 (subordinated 4.40%). $3.0bn five-year revolving credit facility maturing 2029, undrawn at 31-Dec-2025. 2025 issues: $1.0bn 4.3% notes due 2030 and $1.0bn 4.9% notes due 2036.

amort_sched.src: FY2025 Form 10-K Note 7: estimated annual pre-tax amortization of intangible assets (2026 $351m, 2027 $356m, 2028 $357m, 2029 $376m, 2030 $371m).

capital.buyback: Board authorization of up to $20bn of common share repurchases (Dec-2025). Q2-26 10-Q Part II: 6,888 thousand shares repurchased for $2,012m in Q2-26 at an average $292.17; ~$17,988m remaining at 30-Jun-2026. H1-26 purchases of common stock for treasury $4,527m (cash flow statement).
capital.dps: Dividends declared per share (XBRL CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared): 2023 $0.08 a quarter; 2024 $0.28 a quarter (no Q1 declaration; two in Q2); 2025 $0.36 a quarter; 2026 $0.47 a quarter (Q1, Q2).

tax.src: FY2025 Form 10-K MD&A: effective tax rate 14.1% (2024 12.6%); adjusted effective tax rate (non-GAAP) 17.3% (2024 20.1%). Q2-26 Form 10-Q: adjusted ETR 16.7% in Q2-26 and 15.7% in H1-26 (tax benefits on global activities incl. the OBBBA).

price.src: Share price $308.00 provided by the user (12-Oct-2026). For reference, the Q2-26 Form 10-Q Part II reports an average repurchase price of $292.17 in Q2-26.

corrections: None. Known differences (documented, not corrected): company rounding of $1-3m in the non-GAAP bridges (totals computed from unrounded figures); FY2025 FCF quarters (as first published) do not sum to the FY figure because the Q3-25 release added dispositions of PP&E to the definition and re-presented prior periods.
